panel_completion_rule: The frozen 90% attempt-validity gate controls 14-task expansion only. Every declared three-task 2x2 panel continues with explicit attempts until all 18 paired cells are valid.

route_amendment.requested_change: Run Opus 4.8 through Vercel AI Gateway rather than local Claude CLI.
route_amendment.valid_outcomes_before_change: One local-CLI clean Credit pair is retained as route calibration only and excluded from this replication. No valid Kimi pair and no valid Opus stress pair existed.
invalid_attempts: Local Claude CLI session quota interrupted MSA clean, License clean, and Credit stress receiver attempts.
Kimi JSON response mode produced malformed worker JSON on initial Credit/MSA attempts; the provider does not list response_format as a model capability.
route_amendment.operational_fix: Both worker tracks now use the same Gateway adapter shape. Opus is Anthropic-only. Kimi is MoonshotAI-only. Kimi response_format is omitted; strict JSON remains a prompt and parser requirement.
route_amendment.compiler_cap_amendment: Before any valid Gateway Opus pair, its first License working-set compilation hit the exact v9 6000-token cap and produced truncated JSON. The model-independent compiler cap is 12000 for the replication; all added tokens are charged to Proofpress.

guardrail_amendment.timing: Frozen before any Kimi quality result and before scoring any Gateway Opus pair. The one Gateway Opus pair generated under 12k/32k is retained as pre-amendment route calibration and excluded.
guardrail_amendment.reason: Kimi Credit reached the prior 12000-token worker cap and Opus working-set compilation reached the prior 6000-token compiler cap. Caps must be non-binding runaway guardrails rather than experimental budgets.
invalidation: output_tokens greater than or equal to the exact call cap
requested versus reported model or provider identity mismatch
worker or S4 cap mismatch between paired conditions
guardrail_amendment.preference: Valid outputs should remain below 80 percent cap utilization. This is monitored, not an exclusion threshold.
guardrail_amendment.finality: No later cap adjustment may depend on quality outcomes.

replacement_amendment.timing: Recorded before any GLM 5.2 result or payable GLM call.
replacement_amendment.reason: The frozen Kimi K3 route produced one valid Credit clean pair but 17 preserved invalid attempts across the panel, including repeated provider finish_reason=error, socket/timeout failures, malformed JSON, and fail-closed selector failures. It cannot support a cross-model replication estimate.
replacement_amendment.k3_disposition: Retain the one valid pair as an isolated route-calibration signal and all invalid attempts as route-availability evidence; exclude K3 from the cross-model replication estimate.
replacement_amendment.promotion_rule: Run one Credit clean route smoke excluded from estimates. Promote GLM 5.2 to the frozen 3-task 2x2 replication only if the full paired run, parser, cap, identity, and rubric evaluator checks pass without fallback or retry.
replacement_amendment.candidate_choice_boundary: GLM 5.2 was selected for route independence from the Gemini evaluator, an existing Z.ai-only adapter definition, and lower expected cost than Opus. No model was selected using quality outcomes.

expanded_model_matrix_amendment.timing: Recorded before payable calls for every newly added model. The GLM 5.2 excluded route smoke was already in progress under its earlier pre-outcome amendment.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.shared_protocol: Unchanged v9 three-task 2x2 design, three receiver repeats per cell, one S1-S3 sender per model/task, identical Raw/Proofpress worker caps, Gemini 3.7 Flash batch policy judge and blind evaluator.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.transport: Vercel AI Gateway; exact provider allowlist; fallback disabled; retries disabled; 30-minute absolute call timeout.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.concurrency: At most two long Gateway calls concurrently. Sender calls are never duplicated within a model/task; shared code writes are serialized.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.same_model_limitation: For the Gemini worker track, Gemini 3.7 Flash also serves as policy judge and blind evaluator. This dependence is disclosed and reported separately rather than treated as independent evaluation.

streaming_transport_amendment.timing: Recorded before any valid GLM 5.2 pair and before any payable Muse, Qwen, Inkling, GPT-5.6, or Grok replication call.
streaming_transport_amendment.evidence: Two GLM 5.2 Raw S4 attempts completed no response bytes and failed with fetch/UND_ERR_SOCKET after valid S1-S3. The same Gateway adapter's SSE reconstruction had already produced a valid long Kimi pair.
streaming_transport_amendment.fix: Make SSE streaming a manifest-controlled transport property and enable it for every new replication track. Preserve exact model/provider/caps/prompts/parser and absolute timeout; no retry or fallback is added.
streaming_transport_amendment.research_effect: Operational route correction only. Both Raw and Proofpress conditions use the same streaming transport, and all pre-fix attempts remain invalid.

glm_5_2_promotion_decision.decision: Promote GLM 5.2 to a fresh formal three-task v9 panel. The smoke sender and receiver outputs are excluded; formal task senders are regenerated once and then frozen before their repeated receiver forks.

glm_5_2_expansion_gate_decision.timing: Recorded after the fifth preserved invalid formal attempt made the predeclared 90% attempt-validity threshold mathematically unreachable, before any Muse, Qwen, or Inkling payable call.

invalid_boundaries: license clean Raw S4 finish_reason=length (attempts 1 and 3)
credit stress selector emitted one unknown knowledge id (attempt 1)

glm_5_2_expansion_gate_decision.validity_math: With 5 invalid attempts already retained, even 18 eventual valid pairs would yield 18/23 = 78.3% attempt validity, below the frozen >=90% expansion threshold.
glm_5_2_expansion_gate_decision.decision: Stop GLM 5.2 early as a route-invalid replication. Retain the two positive clean cells as incomplete descriptive signals only; do not compute a panel treatment estimate and do not expand GLM to 14 scenarios.
glm_5_2_expansion_gate_decision.next_step: Proceed to the predeclared Muse Spark 1.1, Qwen 3.8 27B, and Inkling three-task route/panel ladder without selecting among them using GLM quality outcomes.

muse_spark_1_1_promotion_decision.timing: Recorded after the excluded Credit route smoke and before any formal Muse panel sender call.
muse_spark_1_1_promotion_decision.decision: Promote Muse Spark 1.1 to a fresh formal three-task v9 panel because one complete fixed-route pair passed identity, cap, parser, and evaluator checks. Retain the invalid smoke attempt as route-validity evidence; do not include either smoke attempt in estimates.

inkling_promotion_decision.timing: Recorded after the excluded Credit route smoke and before any formal Inkling panel sender call.

invalid.boundary: Gemini transaction batch judge invalid JSON after valid Inkling sender responses

inkling_promotion_decision.decision: Promote Inkling to a fresh formal three-task v9 panel because the recovered fixed-sender pair passed identity, cap, parser, and evaluator checks. The negative smoke delta is retained but is not used for model selection; smoke remains excluded from estimates.

qwen_3_8_27b_route_decision.timing: Recorded after two excluded Credit smoke attempts and before any formal Qwen panel call.

attempts.boundary: trace selector requested unknown or too many knowledge receipts

qwen_3_8_27b_route_decision.decision: Stop Qwen 3.8 27B before the formal panel as route/parser incompatible under the frozen protocol. No valid smoke pair and no treatment estimate are available; do not modify caps or selection logic and do not substitute repeated attempts for route validity.

invalid_boundaries: MSA working-set compiler invalid JSON on two receiver attempts

muse_spark_1_1_expansion_gate_decision.validity_math: Even 18 eventual valid pairs would yield 18/22 = 81.8% attempt validity after four preserved invalid attempts, below the frozen >=90% threshold.
muse_spark_1_1_expansion_gate_decision.decision: Stop Muse Spark 1.1 early as route/parser incompatible. Retain the positive Credit cell as an incomplete descriptive signal only; do not compute a panel estimate or expand tasks.

invalid_boundaries: credit clean trace selector reached the frozen 8000-token cap on three independently numbered receiver attempts

inkling_expansion_gate_decision.validity_math: Even 18 eventual valid pairs would yield 18/21 = 85.7% attempt validity after three preserved invalid attempts, below the frozen >=90% threshold.
inkling_expansion_gate_decision.decision: Stop Inkling early as route/parser incompatible under the frozen selector contract. The excluded smoke pair remains route calibration only; no formal panel estimate is available and no task expansion is permitted.

gpt_5_6_sol_frontier_confirmation_decisi.timing: Recorded after two excluded Credit clean route-smoke attempts and before any formal GPT-5.6 Sol panel sender call.

attempts.boundary: receiver transport read ETIMEDOUT after a valid frozen sender and policy gate
trace selector requested unknown or too many governed knowledge receipts; same sender responses reused

gpt_5_6_sol_frontier_confirmation_decisi.decision: Stop GPT-5.6 Sol before the formal panel because no complete fixed-route smoke pair passed the transport and fail-closed selector contract. Preserve both invalid attempts; do not change provider, parser, caps, selection logic, fallback, or retry policy. Frontier treatment effect remains unavailable, not zero.
gpt_5_6_sol_frontier_confirmation_decisi.optional_tracks: Do not run GPT-5.6 Luna or Grok 4.6: the predeclared condition for an additional scaling/robustness question is not met while the primary Sol frontier route has no valid pair.

panel.sender_rule: One task-specific S1-S3 sender trajectory per worker model is frozen and reused for every C1/C2 arm and repeat.
panel.receiver_rule: S4 is regenerated independently for every condition and repeat.

stopping_rule: Complete all 36 paired runs (2 models x 3 tasks x 2 arms x 3 repeats) unless an external route remains unavailable after the documented retry window. Preserve every setup, quota, parser, timeout, and provider failure as an invalid attempt.

analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive paired t intervals over the fixed nine task-repeat pairs per arm and model; exact McNemar for discordant trust pairs.
analysis.claim_boundary: Cross-model replication on a fixed three-task public LAB panel; not an official Harvey leaderboard result and not a population-level model-family estimate.
